summary: Tested Gmail SMTP email notification feature for lead captures. All backend APIs and frontend forms working correctly. Email notifications are sent via Gmail SMTP (webadmin@ihgind.com) to sales@metroplusads.com when leads are captured through spec pack downloads or contact form submissions. Verified SMTP connection works and emails are delivered successfully.
